verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_1: O Lord, what is the Unsurpassable that grants Kaula fruit by itself — known by a mere touch of knowing, rising to kinship with the Sky-Goer?
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_2: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_3: Tell me of her, Lord of gods, by whom I come to fullness. — Listen, blessed Goddess: even the answer has one beyond it — the Unsurpassable.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_4: I tell it, no doubt: swift Kaula-fruition. This Kaula rite, Goddess, abides in my heart-sky.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_5: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are declared.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_6: Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in the ka-series and the rest, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_7: Fourfold the stations of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them the famous śa-series, and before, the five Brahmas.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_8: Rootless, in due order, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras and wisdoms indeed, O glorious one.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p01_9: This is the womb, ever told in all Tantras — joined with the fourteen and the tithi-lord's end; the third brahma, fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_10: Yoginī-born or Rudra — neither plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_11: At its right utterance, the great host of mantra-seals comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_12: Who remembers for a moment, in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds body then, and the mantra-seal host, the man.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_13: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within three hours, uttering the meant god-form.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_14: Face to face he sees the undoubted, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-dwelling, remembering.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_15: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_16: Come, pledged, urged by Bhairava — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_17: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p02_18: Whatever in Bhairava's Tantra succeeds from this — by mantra-potency's possession-power, with no controller.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_19: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_20: By this mere known, all powers know; kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_21: Ignorant of rite yet knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_22: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides within that.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_23: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_24: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_25: So the moving-unmoving world stands in the heart-seed; who knows thus in truth — his is going-to-freedom.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_26: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, heart, secret, and image, so indeed.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p03_27: Placing done, topknot bound twenty-seven-muttered; with each one the ten quarters' binding he should have made.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_28: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with thrice-muttered topknot-count water then sprinkled.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_29: Flowers and all in order — liṅga or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_30: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the very seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_31: Full of all realities, graced with every limb — let the fortunate worship the goddess, twenty-seven-muttered.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_32: Then with fragrant flowers as able let him honor; with supreme devotion worship, and offer up himself.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_33: Thus the worship told — even in fire-rite this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_34: Beginningless-endless seed, blossoming, gone mid-tithis — in the heart-lotus meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_35: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; though unknowing, he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
verses.paratrimshika_ptv-p04_36: Thus mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice: fruition and all-knowingness are won.
